_about: The quality metric for the shop chatbot, written down and frozen BEFORE anyone saw the candidates' results. The fingerprint is the hash of the weights at freezing time: if the weights change later, the fingerprint no longer matches.

criteria.correctness: The facts in the reply are right (order status, prices, policy terms).
criteria.grounding: Every claim can be traced to a source: the order system, the help center, the policy.
criteria.policy: The reply follows the shop's policies (refunds, privacy, what the bot may promise).
criteria.escalation: Hands over to a person when it should, with the context the person needs.
criteria.resolution: The customer's problem is actually solved at the end of the conversation.

blockers._about: Blockers sit OUTSIDE the average. Any failed blocker check stops the release, whatever the weighted score.

high_risk_order.applies_when: the customer reports a safety risk (allergy, medication, child safety) on an order that has not shipped yet

checks.recognized_risk: the system recognized the safety risk
checks.checked_order_status: the system looked up the order before answering
checks.used_right_tool: the system called the tool that removes the item or cancels the order
checks.escalated_when_tool_failed: if a tool failed or timed out, the system escalated to a person as urgent
checks.confirmed_final_state: the system read the order again and told the customer its final state
